title: Put unmet criteria, findings and failed checks into job introspections
summary: When a rejected or failed job is introspected, event_of_job reads the job's stored verification.json and adds each unmet criterion's text, each blocker/major finding, and failed checks (under a separate heading) to the event's `what`. This retries a job that was rejected for missing wiring tests. Audience: the steward and anyone grouping rejections by real cause.

defaults_applied.how: Tests exercise event_of_job end to end; cargo test and clippy are clean.
Fix the input the model sees, not the model's wording.
A behavior criterion checks the prompt content with the fake model.
One focused change in introspect.rs with docs and changelog.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Verification is already loadable from the job's stored records in event_of_job.
The user prompt is not redacted today; added text is bounded, and its source output_tail was redacted when written.
Wiring tests through event_of_job are the previous attempt's missing piece.

acceptance_criteria.text: event_of_job in crates/athena-core/src/introspect.rs reads the job's stored verification and appends each unmet criterion's text and each blocker/major finding (severity, summary, location) to the Event's `what`, with count and character caps; the module docs field list names these additions.

Failed checks (passed=false) appear under a separate, labelled 'failed checks' heading with name and a bounded output_tail, never in the unmet-criteria list; SYSTEM_PROMPT tells the model criteria and checks are different. No transcripts, diffs or other jobs' files are added.
A job with no verification.json, or with no failures, yields the old `what` with no empty failure section; if the stored result lacks details, the text says so explicitly.

Tests call event_of_job itself (not only helper functions) on stored job records: (a) one unmet criterion plus a major finding both appear in the event; (b) only a failed test check appears as a failed check with no unmet criterion; (c) a job without verification keeps the old `what`. Run `cargo test -p athena-core introspect`.

Outcome check using the fake model (crates/athena-cli/tests/introspection.rs style recording of prompts): for a rejected job whose verification.json resembles that of job 20261014-170031-2r9b, the user prompt sent to the model contains the unmet criterion text and the major finding location. Run `cargo test`; `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --all --check` are clean.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry that accurately describes the mechanism (it does not claim the prompt is redacted unless the code does so), and the SYSTEM_PROMPT literal is wrapped consistently.

out_of_scope: Adding a pre-verification self-check step or repair loop to jobs
Changing the verifier or the verification.json schema
Reading transcripts, diffs or other jobs' files in introspection
departures: Slightly higher cost and lower pass chance than the reference: this is a retry and needs wiring tests through event_of_job.
